rules: CSRRWI atomically reads the value of the specified CSR, zero-extends the value to XLEN bits, and writes it to integer register rd.
CSRRWI updates the specified CSR using an XLEN-bit value obtained by zero-extending a 5-bit unsigned immediate (uimm[4:0]) field.
If rd = x0 for a CSRRWI instruction, the instruction shall not read the CSR and shall not cause any of the side effects that might occur on a CSR read.
A CSRRWI instruction always writes to the specified CSR.
CSRRWI action side effects for all fields within the written CSR.
